Urea.notes: Apply in splits. Incorporate into soil to minimize volatilization losses.

DAP.notes: Apply near root zone during sowing for optimal phosphorus uptake.

MOP.notes: Apply in splits if soil is sandy. Avoid direct contact with seeds.

10-26-26.notes: Use as a basal dose. Good for crops requiring high P and K.

14-35-14.notes: Excellent for root development. Apply at sowing.

17-17-17.notes: Balanced NPK fertilizer. Apply equally during the crop cycle.

20-20.notes: Good for initial growth. Lacks potassium, so supplement if soil is K deficient.

28-28.notes: High concentration of N and P. Useful for rapid early growth.

default.notes: Follow standard agricultural practices for application.
